caption: Risk Aggregate Finding
description:
The Risk Aggregate Finding aggregates other findings and can represent risk combined from multiple intermediate findings via correlation or time-based accumulation.

Note: If the event producer is a security control, the security_control profile should be applied and its attacks information, if present, should be duplicated into the finding_info object.
Note: If the Finding is an incident, i.e. requires incident workflow, also apply the incident profile.
name: risk_aggregate_finding
